She is the younger sister of [[Clemont]]. ==In the core series games== [[File:XY Bonnie.png|thumb|250px|right|Bonnie in {{g|X and Y}}]] Bonnie is present as an unwavering companion and supporter for her brother during his Gym battle with the player character. During the player's challenge of the Gym, she runs the quiz that the player must solve in order to challenge Clemont. After defeating Clemont, Bonnie can be found on the first floor of the [[Lumiose Gym]] at [[Prism Tower]]. If talked to with a Pokémon with max [[Affection]] in front of the party, she will award the player with a {{DL|List of Ribbons in the games|Best Friends Ribbon}}. Clemont and Bonnie do not appear in {{g|Legends: Z-A}}, though they are mentioned by some NPCs in Lumiose City. {{color2|000|Pokémon X and Y|X and Y}} |} ==In animation== [[File:Bonnie anime.png|thumb|250px|Bonnie in {{aniseries|XY}}]] {{main|Bonnie (anime)}} Bonnie appears in ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]'' as a {{ashfr|traveling companion}} for {{Ash}} alongside {{an|Serena}} and her brother {{an|Clemont}}. She and Clemont first met Ash in ''[[XY001|Kalos, Where Dreams and Adventures Begin!]]'', but they officially began traveling with him in ''[[XY003|A Battle of Aerial Mobility!]]''. She also reappeared in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'' for a [[JN103|two-part]] [[JN104|episode]] set in Kalos. {{-}} ==In the manga== [[File:Bonnie Adventures.png|thumb|130px|Bonnie in Pokémon Adventures]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== Bonnie debuted in ''[[PS563|Charging After Electrike]]''. She was first seen entering the [[Prism Tower]], only to find the aftermath of a {{pkmn|battle}} between {{adv|X}} and the [[Lumiose Press editor-in-chief]], a member of [[Team Flare]]. To her shock, Bonnie noticed an {{p|Electrike}} that helped keep the tower active during a blackout had gone missing. She then went off to inform [[Clemont]] about what happened. In ''[[PS592|Zygarde Agitated]]'', Bonnie, Clemont, [[Alexa]], [[Viola]], and [[Yvette]] confronted Team Flare at {{rt|10|Kalos}}. Together, the group managed to successfully free the Pokémon Team Flare had captured. After Team Flare was fully defeated, Bonnie and her allies met with X and his friends at [[Lumiose City]] to congratulate them on their victory. She and Clemont also returned Furry, {{adv|Shauna}}'s missing {{p|Furfrou}}, to its Trainer. ====Pokémon==== =====On hand===== {| width="50%" |- | {{ActivePoké|Clemont|Dedenne|Bonnie Dedenne Adventures.png|electric|fairy|link=Clemont's Dedenne#Pokémon Adventures}} | |} =====At Prism Tower===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Bonnie |pkmn=Electric-type Pokémon |type1=Electric |img=Prism Tower Pokémon Adventures.png |epnum=PS562 |epname=Pangoro Poses a Problem |desc=These Electric Pokémon were used to Power the Prism Tower during a blackout. It was rescued by Bonnie and her friends and was later returned to Shauna.}} ==In the TCG== [[File:BonnieForbiddenLight103.jpg|200px|thumb|Full Art print of Bonnie]] {{main|Bonnie (Forbidden Light 103)}} '''Bonnie''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] during the English Sun & Moon Series (the Japanese SM Era). It was first released in the Japanese {{TCG|Forbidden Light}} expansion before debuting in English in the {{TCG|Forbidden Light|expansion of the same name}}, with the background artwork by [[Hideki Ishikawa]]. It was also released as a {{TCG|Full Art card}} in Forbidden Light, with an illustration by the same artist.
